m.title: Obst, Bogumił Fryderyk (I3423) - Marriage, 1839 (C1174)

events.note: C1174 includes his marriage to Anna Marianna Winterfeld, age 24, born to parents Krystian and Katarzyna Winterfeld. The marriage took place in Michalinowo on 1839-02-03. Anna Marianna Winterfeld was born "in the village of Strellen in Brandeburg outside Berlin in the Perliberg district" according to the document.
